notes: Fixes the core same-module for_each/count drop. Parent-over-child override still works at the whole-resource level, so a parent import for one instance silently drops child imports for other instances (likely the 2 failing hidden tests); it also adds an unnecessary string-based sort and a heuristic configs.StaticToAddr helper for import-config lookup, which widen scope.

Fixes the reported same-module for_each case and finds the per-instance import config by re-parsing the To expression via a new configs.StaticToAddr; however, it still deduplicates parent/child imports per ConfigResource rather than per instance, so a child-module import can still be silently dropped, and it adds unneeded sorting and a new public API in the configs package.

Correctly keeps all same-module blocks and threads the right import config per instance through knownImports, a coherent improvement over importTargets[0]. Like the others, parent overrides child per ConfigResource rather than per instance, so mixed parent/child instance imports are still silently dropped; the signature changes are fairly invasive.

Keeps all same-module blocks and threads each block's import config through knownImports, which cleanly fixes the importTargets[0].Config association, but still applies parent-overrides-child at ConfigResource level instead of at instance expansion, so cross-module per-instance cases differ from the reference.

A clean, minimal fix that passes an ancestor set down the module tree so all same-module blocks for a resource are kept. Override is still at ConfigResource level rather than per instance as in the reference, leaving the parent/child mixed-instance drop; tests cover only the basic for_each plan plus a unit test.

A minimal, clean change using an ancestor-set that fixes the reported bug, but it keeps ConfigResource-level parent/child deduplication rather than moving it to instance expansion as the reference does, and its tests are limited to one plan test plus a unit test that depends on fixture line numbers.

Clean helpers and it handles the HasSuffix and `{}` cases, but it leaves doImport's brace-nesting switch and anonymous-block check untouched, so quoted braces still miscount snippet nesting in imported files; tests are numerous but some (lexer, formatter) don't exercise the fix and the snippet test only checks keys.

Clean helpers that cover the dispenser, directive() (including the quoted "{}" branch), the address HasSuffix check and blockTokens, but it entirely omits the doImport nesting switch. As a result, quoted braces in imported files still break snippet detection and `{block}`/args handling. Some added lexer and formatter tests only exercise code that was not changed.

Covers every brace check the reference touches, including doImport nesting, the anonymous-block check and the `{}` restructuring, but misses the address HasSuffix case, repeats inline `!Quoted()` checks instead of a helper, and adds unrequested error-message and blockContents behavior; tests are excellent, including the imported-snippet `{block}` case.

Fixes quoted braces across the dispenser and the parser, including the doImport nesting switch and the anonymous-block check, and it has thorough tests (including a test for an imported snippet with quoted braces). However, it repeats inline `Quoted()` checks instead of using a helper, adds an unrequested quoted-brace error path in blockContents/openCurlyBrace/closeCurlyBrace, adds an error-expectation adapt file that relies on the harness supporting errors, and leaves the address HasSuffix check unchanged.

Nearly identical to the reference, using clean Token helper methods across the dispenser, parser and doImport nesting; it skips minor spots (quoted `{}` branch ordering, anonymous-block mapping key, address HasSuffix), and its parse, dispenser and adapt tests are focused and adequate.

A clean `Token` helper approach that closely mirrors the reference across the dispenser, directive(), doImport nesting, blockTokens and the open/close assertions, with focused parse, dispenser and adapt tests. It misses the anonymous-block key check, the quoted "{}" branch, and the address HasSuffix check, all of which are minor.
